Curious about a thorough heart health check in Saudi Arabia?

The Cardiac Risk Assessment is offered at King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Centre in Riyadh.
It provides a one‑day outpatient evaluation with cardiology consultation, ECG, and core bloodwork.
A post‑results consultation and personalized preventive plan are included to guide lifestyle adjustments.

Read the full guide:
https://www.placidway.com/package/8699/Cardiac-Risk-Assessment-Package-in-Riyadh-Saudi-Arabia-at-KFSHRC
